name: Mother Puckers | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Super Sour Chews
description:
Mother Puckers Mixed Fruit Super Sour Chews are the OGs for a reason. Every package contains six loud, individually flavored chews — not a mystery mix:

Orange • Watermelon • Blue Raspberry • Black Cherry • Strawberry • Green Apple

Each chew is sour-coated, juicy as hell, and built to slap. Infused with 200mg of THC from solventless Live Rosin, this Sativa-leaning formula delivers full-spectrum flavor and effects. Expect bright energy, smooth lift, and a clean ride — perfect for daytime or leveling up your vibe.
